title: If a lot of people making similar game, mb they should unite
author: R_dva
selftext:
there was many posts about wow like rpg, why you not gather together make it better?  
or other games like fishing or about sailing?

replies.author: R_dva
replies.body: what the problem, do u think ur fishing game will be better than my? Or you think you can solo beat blizzard with your version of WoW?

comments.author: Three_Tails_Studio
comments.body: Coming together to create one product does not mean it will be better. Instead, we all need to be more supportive and collaborate on processes that are conducive to a better product.

replies.author: theflossboss1
replies.body: Most of this sub will just immediately try to copy a game and put it out faster if the idea gets any positive community traction.  Think of all the games that are getting copycats within a week of publishing

comments.author: ipreuss
comments.body:
Because we are unlikely to agree what “better” means. 

Which is a good thing - diversity makes our lives richer.

comments.author: 3tt07kjt
comments.body: Teams are great but I think a lot of people using AI like not working with other people. (Too bad for them!)

comments.author: Initial_Plastic_8069
comments.body: Probably some would spend more money than others, friction would starts and the machine

comments.author: DiscountCthulhu01
comments.body: Tell me you know f all about game dev without telling me you know f all about game dev. .. but then again,  checks out for this sub

comments.author: Mrbuttshaman
comments.body: It's hard to find people passionate about game dev that are willing to go at it for the love of the game.

comments.author: gay_married
comments.body: That's kind of the concept of open source. I do wish there were more open source games.

comments.author: derLeisemitderLaute
comments.body: I see your idea, but I dont think I would do that. Working in a team always means to make compromises. AI lets me cut the rest of the workfront to make my visions come alive. I dont want it blurr them with other people.

comments.author: Fuzzzy420
comments.body: Sure. Anyone wants to help build a 3d top down hardcore twinstick shooter?
